speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with significant constitutional symptoms like night sweats and weight loss alongside abdominal pain and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as alternating diarrhea or constipation, or any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That significant weight loss combined with drenching night sweats and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy raises concern for a systemic process like lymphoma or a malignancy. Have you noticed any pain or swelling specifically in the epigastric region, or have you seen or felt any new lumps elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The "fixed" nature of the supraclavicular node and your constitutional symptoms are highly concerning for malignancy. Have you experienced any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or pain when swallowing?

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis.
